int_name: N BROAD ST & W GLENWOOD AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial arterial with marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island increases exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time of exposure in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection crossing the main arterial.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no central island for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for people attempting to cross the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian presence and does not guide pedestrians to a safe path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians without any mid-crossing refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and a bus shelter are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The corner near the gas station has a wide radius that allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the gas station entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the high-speed roadway.
